label: 跪姿前撑回头
pose_lead: Grounded pose, kneeling forward lean with a look back:
lower_limbs: Both knees bend on the ground, the hips rising back and up, the feet tucked behind.
upper_limbs: Both arms reach forward and down, the hands or fingertips touching the ground.
torso_head: The upper body leans forward while the head and shoulders rotate back toward the rear side.
weight_silhouette: The pelvis and the shoulder line point different directions, forward lean and twist together; a strongly dynamic shape.
